description: Live prediction-market board scan, $0.25. Returns the whole active board ranked by 24h volume: every market's implied probabilities, spreads, book depth, 24h/1wk volume, days to resolution and 0-100 edge scores, plus a summary of where the board is least certain - the live close calls (near 50/50), the widest spreads, the sharpest 24h moves, and total board volume. Use to screen prediction markets for mispricing, monitor event risk, or find the events the market itself cannot call. One request, whole board.

min_volume.description: Only markets with at least this much 24h volume (USD)
